Omar: Quick heads-up — planning a hotfix for 1.12.5 to address a kv-cache edge-case that popped up in canary. Need expedited cutoff + minimal diffs.
release-bot: Release window reserved: slot at 16:00 UTC. Please update this thread when ready.
Leah: What are the exact diffs? Can we avoid touching runtime code? Need a changelog entry.
Omar: Yes minimal: bump patch, cherry-pick two commits from main (abc123, def456). No runtime changes — just kvcache guard + tests.
Omar: ```bash
git checkout -b hotfix/1.12.5
git cherry-pick abc123
git cherry-pick def456
git commit -m "chore: bump 1.12.5, kvcache guard"
git push origin hotfix/1.12.5
```
Sam: I'll open the backport PR and add changelog snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321
Emily: Changelog suggestion: "fix(kv-cache): avoid OOB read on empty-prefix for long sequences" — short and reference issue #987.
Leah: I'll run smoke tests after PR merges. Can we aim for 15:30 UTC smoke so we can cut at 16:00?
Omar: Yes. Also plan to enable canary on prod-safe route at 10% for 10m after cut.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll add rollout policy in the release config. Adding stanza: `canary: {percent:10, duration:600}`
release-bot: Reminder: branch freeze in 30 minutes before cutover. Priority set to "hotfix".
Emily: If smoke passes, I'll tag and publish the patch and merge back to main. I can do tagging/publish at ~16:05 UTC.
Leah: Noted. If any flakiness in smoke, we'll roll back immediately and open revert PRs. @Sam please keep alert.
Sam: On call and monitoring :eyes: — will watch deploy logs, token latency, and error rates.
Omar: Thanks all. Post final smoke status here so PMs can be notified. cc @product
